translations.answer: The original code first executes model.createData(), then model.addFrame(frame), and uses the old data to compute the Jacobian. A project member pointed out that the Data should not be modified after model.createData() is called; the original author confirmed this was their order. The handling is to complete model modifications such as addFrame() before creating the Data; when modifying the Model later, the Data should also be rebuilt. The original author confirmed the order was incorrect.
translations.applicability: Applies to the original post Pinocchio 2.6.19/Python 3.10.4 and similar model structure modification processes; other versions should recheck the API semantics.
translations.credibility.rationale: There is engineering record of the environment, processing steps, and results, but formal cross-verification or independent replication is lacking.
translations.details.attempts.0: The project member suggested moving model.createData() after model.addFrame(frame); another contributor agreed with this diagnosis, and the original author confirmed the order was incorrect.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Checking the order of model.createData() and model.addFrame(): the original example changed the Model's frame structure after Data was already created.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: Complete all Model structure modifications before calling model.createData(); if the Model is modified again, re-create the corresponding Data before running Jacobian/kinematic algorithms.
translations.details.environments.0: Pinocchio 2.6.19 (pip); Python 3.10.4; UR5 URDF; x86_64 Linux, Intel i7-8550U.
translations.details.limits.0: Original thread did not provide the full running output after adjustment or regression testing.
translations.details.limits.1: The phenomenon and version boundary come from Pinocchio 2.6.19; do not infer that other versions behave in the same way.
translations.details.outcomes.0: Original author confirmed adding frames after initializing Data and accepted the correction. Issue was subsequently marked as completed.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: Pinocchio calls getFrameJacobian randomly causes segmentation faults, bus errors, or double free; check which object's lifetime is the issue.
translations.details.safety_notes.0: For real-machine WBC, prevent torque application when dynamics data structures are inconsistent; do not rely solely on process crash as a protection.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: Project member confirmed that Pinocchio Data was created before Pinocchio Model.
translations.details.symptoms.0: Same script causes unstable segmentation faults, bus errors, corrupted double-linked list, or double free.
